annotations.title: Local plan policies and settlement position for a site

description:
The planning policy picture for a site: the adopted and emerging local
    plan with stage and dates, the local plan policies whose areas cover the
    site (reference, name, theme, a text extract, the share of the site),
    the settlement position (inside, outside or straddling a settlement
    boundary, with the distance to its edge), neighbourhood plans and the
    green belt review rating of the parcel.

    Policies are DIGITISED from the council's own layers and documents:
    quote the policy reference and source, not our wording. Each layer says
    its coverage; `not_held` means we hold no boundary for that authority,
    NOT that the site is outside a settlement. Give exactly ONE scope: `location` ("lat,lng"), `postcode`,
    `area_geojson` (a red line, GeoJSON in WGS84, at most 150 km² and 64
    vertices), `land_id` or `lpa_code` (GSS, e.g. E07000240); anything else is
    refused before any read and nothing is charged. UK only. Free.
name: policy_context
